zh-CN.title: 第三方应用授权管理
items: 开发者可提交第三方应用申请，并查看审核结果
授权页展示已审核的应用与权限；读取邮箱地址需要单独同意

en.title: Third-party application permissions
items: Developers can submit third-party applications and see review results
Consent shows reviewed apps and permissions; reading an email address requires separate consent
